claim: Satellite internet: Starlink's 2025 progress report (published 28 January 2026) states it connects more than 9 million customers after adding more than 4.6 million new active customers and 35 markets in 2025, and that its third-generation satellites, targeted to launch in 2026, are designed for over 1 Tbps downlink each.

verification.note: Report content (9M+ customers, 4.6M+ new active customers, 35 new markets, Gen3 in 2026 with >1 Tbps downlink) is in the PDF, but the date is wrong: the PDF states no publication date, and the report was already out on 31 Dec 2025 (Starlink X post 2006476781994520686) and covered by Quilty Space on 6 Jan 2026 ('SpaceX just published'). The 28 Jan 2026 event/published date is unsupported and no cited source states the real date; the 9M figure is also carried by 2026-06-04-starlink-12m-customers.
